description: Read ONE template in full — subject, HTML body, fromEmail, type, version, and the {{variables}} it expects. volanea_list_resources and volanea_create_template both return summaries WITHOUT the body, so this is the only way to see the actual content; that split is deliberate, because echoing a full HTML body into every listing costs thousands of tokens you cannot act on. Use it to inspect or restyle existing content, and to check which placeholders a send must supply before calling /v1/send. Do NOT use it to discover ids — volanea_list_resources { templates } is far cheaper for that. Returns 404 for an unknown id rather than an empty template, so a typo fails loudly.

templateId.description: The `tmpl-…` id, exactly as returned by volanea_create_template or volanea_list_resources { templates }.

name: volanea_get_template

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

body.description: Full HTML, which no listing returns.

detectedVariables.description: Placeholders every send of this template must supply.

type.description: transactional or marketing — decides whether unsubscribed contacts receive it.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
